prompt: A scheduled overtime job kept one machine running past six on Friday, and another machine started before the Monday reading. Which record should staff submit?
promptZh: 有一台機器因排定的加班工作在星期五運轉超過六點，另一台在星期一讀表前就已啟動。員工應送出哪一種紀錄？

options.text: Friday’s reading after the overtime job; Monday’s reading and start time, with no total.
options.zh: 星期五加班工作完成後的讀數；星期一讀數及啟動時間，不填總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期一處理正確，但星期五仍應在六點讀表，不能等加班工作結束。

options.text: Friday’s six o’clock reading and job note; Monday’s reading and the unadjusted weekend total.
options.zh: 星期五六點讀數與工作註記；星期一讀數及未調整的週末總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期五處理正確，但星期一必須註記啟動時間且總用電留白。

options.text: Friday’s six o’clock reading without a job note; Monday’s reading and start time, with no total.
options.zh: 星期五六點讀數，不註記工作；星期一讀數及啟動時間，不填總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期一處理正確，但星期五還需註記正在進行的加班工作。

options.text: Friday’s six o’clock reading and job note; Monday’s reading and start time, with no total.
options.zh: 星期五六點讀數與工作註記；星期一讀數及啟動時間，不填總用電。
options.whyZh: 星期五按時讀表並註記加班；星期一記下讀數和啟動時間，把週末總用電留白。

evidence: Take the six o'clock reading anyway, and mark the job on the sheet. | If a machine has already started, record the meter reading and the machine's start time. In that case, leave the weekend-total box empty
explanationZh: 星期五按時讀表並註記加班；星期一記下讀數和啟動時間，把週末總用電留白。
difficultyRationale: Combine two distinct contingency branches; every distractor satisfies one complete branch but fails the other.

vocabulary.note: figure 在此是數值；和直接相減得到的未調整讀值不同。
